title: SACQ: Structure-Aware Codebook Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.41408v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable capable robot behavior, but their large memory footprint limits deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Weight quantization is a natural remedy, yet post-training quantization (PTQ) recipes inherited from large language models degrade when applied to VLAs at ultra-low precision. Existing low-bit PTQ methods often fail to explicitly account for the structure of downstream operations and allocate precision without considering its effect on the policy actions. We introduce SACQ, an ultra- low-bit weight-only vector-codebook quantization framework for VLAs. translated_title: SACQ：面向超低比特视觉-语言-动作模型的结构感知码本量化
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够实现强大的机器人行为能力，但其庞大的内存占用限制了在资源受限的机器人平台上的部署。权重量化是一种自然的解决方案，然而继承自大语言模型的训练后量化（PTQ）方法在应用于超低精度的VLA模型时性能会下降。现有的低比特PTQ方法往往未能显式考虑下游操作的结构，并且在分配精度时没有考虑其对策略动作的影响。我们提出了SACQ，一个面向VLA模型的超低比特仅权重向量码本量化框架。SACQ结合了：(1) 结构感知码本拟合，采用反映输入统计特性和下游敏感性的角色特定二次度量；(2) 基于单个层被压缩时最终动作误差增量的动作感知混合比特分配；(3) 两阶段量化后精炼，重新分配码字
tldr: SACQ提出了一种面向视觉-语言-动作模型的超低比特码本量化框架，通过结构感知码本拟合、动作感知的混合比特分配和两阶段量化后精炼，在极低精度下有效压缩模型同时保持策略动作的性能。
en_tdlr: SACQ is an ultra-low-bit codebook quantization framework for Vision-Language-Action models that combines structure-aware codebook fitting, action-aware mixed-bit allocation, and two-stage post-quantization refinement to compress models at extremely low precision while preserving policy action performance.
